name: application-toggles
title: Toggles
description: On/off switch controls for binary settings and preferences, implemented as styled checkboxes with base, icon-adorned, material, and Apple-style visual variants.
useWhen: Enabling or disabling a binary setting that takes effect immediately without a save button, such as notifications or dark mode.
A settings page lists multiple independently togglable features that users can turn on or off.
The on/off metaphor communicates the action better than a checkbox label like 'Yes/No'.
avoidWhen: The setting only takes effect after a form is submitted — use a checkbox inside a form instead.
Multiple related options can be selected together — use a checkbox group.
The control represents a non-binary state (three or more states) — use radio buttons or a select.
responsiveBehavior: Toggle switches maintain their size across viewports. Touch targets should be at least 44×44px; the label area can extend the hit target on mobile.
accessibility: Use a native <input type='checkbox'> with role='switch' to convey the on/off semantics to screen readers.
Each toggle must have an associated visible <label> — do not rely on placeholder text or tooltip alone.
The checked state must be communicated via the checked attribute, not color alone.

variants.title: Base
variants.description: Standard pill-shaped toggle switch using a styled checkbox, the default for settings pages and preference lists.
accessibility: Requires a linked <label>; use role='switch' with aria-checked for accurate screen reader announcement.

variants.title: Base (Dark)
variants.description: Standard toggle switch adapted for dark application surfaces with dark track and light thumb.
accessibility: Toggle track and thumb colors must meet contrast requirements in both on and off states on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Base with icon
variants.description: Toggle switch with a small icon inside the thumb (such as a sun/moon or check/cross) to reinforce the on/off state beyond color.
accessibility: Icon inside the thumb is decorative when the label describes the setting; set aria-hidden='true' on the icon.

variants.title: Base with icon (Dark)
variants.description: Icon-adorned toggle adapted for dark surfaces, with thumb icon visible against the dark track on both on and off states.
accessibility: Thumb icon and track colors must meet contrast requirements in both checked and unchecked states on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Material
variants.description: Material Design-style toggle with a circular thumb that extends slightly beyond the pill track — a familiar pattern for Android-native UI aesthetics.
accessibility: Material styling does not change the underlying checkbox semantics; role='switch' and aria-checked still required.

variants.title: Material (Dark)
variants.description: Material Design toggle adapted for dark surfaces, with the elevated thumb and track visible against dark backgrounds.
accessibility: Thumb elevation shadow must be visible on dark backgrounds; track color must contrast sufficiently.

variants.title: Apple
variants.description: iOS/macOS-style toggle with a pill-shaped track and large circular thumb — most recognizable to users accustomed to Apple platform settings.
accessibility: Apple-style visual treatment is purely aesthetic; accessibility semantics remain identical to the base toggle.

variants.title: Apple (Dark)
variants.description: iOS/macOS-style toggle adapted for dark surfaces with the green active track and white thumb visible on dark backgrounds.
accessibility: Active track green and inactive track grey must meet contrast requirements against dark application backgrounds.
